text:
IncidentBot: AUTOMATED INCIDENT 5467891234 -> sudden uptick in 5xx (502/504/timeouts) for /v1/chat.generate in eu-west-1. Paging oncall.
Ravi P: I'm oncall. @ana @nora plz ack. I see gateway spike and a cluster of KV read errors in observability. Kicking off triage.
Ana L: ack. pulling KV shard telemetry. Shard set eu-kv-5 showing compaction throughput burst and eviction_count jump, hot_prefix read latency climbing.
Nora H: Support queue has several escalations: "generation failing with 502" from customer XenoLabs and internal synthetic monitors. Severity high.
Ravi P: quick check: are we seeing checksum or validation errors in the kv logs?
Ana L: yes, snippet from eu-kv-5 node-12 logs:
```
2026-03-15T02:11:02Z ERROR compactor node=node-12 shard=eu-kv-5 seg=452 validate=failed err=checksum_mismatch expected=0x7b2a got=0x6f1c
2026-03-15T02:11:03Z WARN cache prefix="u/chat/" evict key=0x4f2 reason=score_threshold
2026-03-15T02:11:04Z INFO prefetch start prefix="u/chat/" backpressure=0.9
```
Ana L: looks like compaction produced a segment with checksum mismatch that later triggered aggressive eviction and a huge flurry of prefetch/backfills, causing backend saturation and gateway 502s.
Nora H: hypothesis: recent compactor tuning (v2.7.0-alpha) changed bucket decay and compaction window, making handoffs race with writes.
Ravi P: impact assessment: error rate jumped from 0.2% to 5.4% in 8 minutes. Estimated affected requests ~12k in last 10m. Customers: XenoLabs, BetaData reported failures. We'll mark high-impact.
Product Ops: confirming customer list. drafting initial status update now.
Ravi P: immediate mitigation plan: (A) stop compactor on eu region, (B) disable aggressive prefetch/parallel backfills, (C) route new generation traffic away from affected shards, (D) enable fallback stale-serving for prefixes for 2m.
Ana L: running stop compactor for eu:
`/ops/services control stop --service=kv-compactor --region=eu`
Ana L: compactor stopped at 5467891320. Observability shows compaction ops drop to zero.
IncidentBot: compactor stop event logged 5467891320
Nora H: toggling prefetch off for eu-kv-5
`/infra/kvcfg set --shard eu-kv-5 --prefetch enabled=false`
Nora H: prefetch disabled at 5467891335. Expect more backend reads but avoids flooding compactor/backfill loops.
Ravi P: updating routing: move 25% of traffic off eu-kv-5 to eu-kv-3 and eu-kv-4 to reduce hot-key pressure. Applying gradual shift.
`/router traffic-shift --from=eu-kv-5 --to=eu-kv-3,eu-kv-4 --percent=25 --duration=2m`
Ana L: applying conservative circuit-breaker on cache miss fanout: max_miss_concurrency=40, per-prefix-rate=5/s
`/ops/configs apply --service=frontline --region=eu --circuit-breaker '{"max_miss_concurrency":40,"per_prefix_rate":5}'`
Ravi P: also enabling stale fallback: serve last-good value for prefix hits for 120s when backend read fails.
`/ops/configs apply --service=cache-proxy --region=eu --fallback_ttl=120s`
Support Bot: status updated: "Investigating increased 502/504 errors in EU. Mitigations underway; temporary degraded throughput and higher latencies possible."
Nora H: after these mitigations 5xx rate dropped from 5.4% -> 1.1% in ~6 minutes. Gateway timeouts still elevated but trending down.
Ana L: digging root cause: compactor change in v2.7.0-alpha introduced 'decay_fast=false' which increased compaction overlap probability. File: compactor/scoreboard.go line 218. That allowed compaction to proceed while segment checksum validation was still racing with concurrent writes.
Ravi P: is there any durable corruption? are reads returning bad data or just checksum detects and rejects?
Ana L: checksums triggered rejects at read-validate, which caused readers to fall back to range repair/prefetch. No persistent data corruption detected on disk; primary risk is compaction race and in-memory checksum transient mismatch.
Product Ops: we'll schedule customer follow-up. Next update in 30m. Provide mitigations and timeline.
Ravi P: action items: Ana to produce RCA with trace correlation (compaction windows vs eviction spikes). Nora to own rollback/patch plan and safer rollout gating. Product Ops to notify impacted customers and prepare mitigation notes. I'll keep incident lead and monitor for another 30m.
Ana L: capturing traces and saving to incident bucket: s3://incidents/5467891234/traces.tar.gz. Will attach checksums and timeline.
Nora H: plan for next steps: (1) revert compactor change in staging and run long-duration soak with synthetic hot-prefix load, (2) add gating that prevents compaction if segment validation is in-progress, (3) implement backpressure on prefetch so it won't exceed available compaction bandwidth.
Ravi P: when do we consider incident mitigated? once 5xx < 0.1% for 30m and no active compaction ops on eu that overlap with writes. Keep prefetch disabled until compactor patch is validated.
IncidentBot: incident state: partial mitigation at 5467891460. Monitoring continues. Postmortem ticket created: INC-2026-03-15-042. Handoff scheduled at 5467891540.
Product Ops: filing communications draft and will send to support ops. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
